reading.title: Beacon Point payment in lieu of taxes request

candidates.quote: Staff recommends that the Council adopt the attached resolution approving a 15-year payment in lieu of taxes for Beacon Point.
candidates.wording: approving a 15-year payment in lieu of taxes

candidates.quote: 3.1 Units. The owner will reserve 16 of the 80 homes as affordable homes.
candidates.wording: reserve 16 of the 80 homes as affordable homes

candidates.quote: 3.2 Income basis. Each affordable home must be leased to a household with income at or below 60 percent of area median income.
candidates.wording: at or below 60 percent of area median income

candidates.quote: 3.3 Rent limits. Rents for the affordable homes may not exceed the 60 percent rent limit based on the HUD income limits published each year.
candidates.wording: may not exceed the 60 percent rent limit

candidates.quote: 3.4 Term. The affordability requirements will last for 30 years from the date the first affordable home is leased.
3.5 Responsible party. The owner, and any later owner of the property, is responsible for meeting these requirements.
candidates.wording: The owner, and any later owner of the property, is responsible

candidates.quote: 3.6 Reporting. The owner will file an annual compliance certificate with the City by March 1 of each year.
3.7 Remedies. If a default is not cured within 60 days after written notice, the owner must repay all abated taxes with interest.
candidates.wording: repay all abated taxes with interest
candidates.value: repay all abated taxes with interest after 60-day cure period
